limitations: The mapping of 3007/3008/3010 to normal, primary tumor and lymph node metastasis tissue is not in the deposit or paper text; organism part and disease are therefore 'not available' and the three samples cannot be compared from the SDRF alone. No factor value column was added.

Deposited search outputs are Mascot .dat files (fragment tolerance 0.1 Da, variable acetyl protein N-term and oxidation M); the PRIDE/paper text describes a PEAKS v8.5 search (0.02 Da, deamidation N/Q variable). The SDRF follows the deposited files; deamidation is not recorded and the PEAKS fragment tolerance is not represented.

Age and sex come from the PRIDE project description (35 years old male patient); the paper full text was read for sample context. The individual label 'patient_1' was formatted to meet the template pattern.

Revised after review: the human template was dropped and base declared (disease and organism part have no honest value because the 3007/3008/3010 tissue mapping is unresolved); biological replicate is 1 for each sample (they are distinct tissues of one patient, not replicates). Instrument Q Exactive and HCD were confirmed from three RAW headers by the independent reviewer.
